The '''graul''' was a large predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was the planet's top predator and similar to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] except for the skin tone, which tended to be more green, and a pair of horns protruding from its head.<ref name="FPtP" />

Grauls could be domesticated by skilled [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] and used as mounts for transportation.<ref name="SWG:C6">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild</ref>

==History==
In [[3626 BBY]], one graul was known to make its home in the tunnels beneath the ruins of the [[Jedi Enclave]], when it was promptly slain by [[Aryn Leneer]], [[Arn Peralun]] and the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>
[[File:Graul_SWG.jpg|right|thumb|A graul.]]
A few years later, in [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>, one Graul was living on a territory of the [[Jannimak crash site]], where it was attacked by ship's droids. Not every [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] scientist present on the site knew what a Graul is, but [[Naul|Professor Naul]], recognizing the creature, sent GSI contractors to defend it.<ref name="Jannimak">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Graul Graveyard|Dantooine}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a spacer fought and killed two graul marauders on Dantooine as part of his trials to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="SWG:SotF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Publish 9: "Secrets of the Force"</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the collector [[Kakirk]] tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of grauls.<ref name="SWG:GG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Graul Gasher}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Graul_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Grauls appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They were originally designed for use on the planet Dathomir as a rival to the fearsome rancors, but the designers later chose to relocate them to Dantooine.<ref name="FPtP" /> Grauls were made craftable mounts for players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>

For the [[2021]] Update 6.3 of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] digital expansion to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a temporary model was used for the graul in the Public Test Server. The creature possessed a brown, armored body, and two horns portruded from its head. Horns were also featured on the graul's elbows.<ref name="Secrets-temp">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}} &mdash; Public Test Server</ref>
